test_item_verbatim: · When STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = [RUN], RVC image active, Shift Lever chagne to Reverse Gear_Stat.info = [REVERSE] > Reverse_Deb, the Head Unit shall continue to display RVC image and switch to the Automatic Display mode.

tcs.tc_title: Atl-Mi, read the HU display and check that the rear view camera image is displayed in Automatic Display Mode
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The rear view camera image is displayed in Manual Display Mode
4. The shift lever is in P
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts = 1 (Inserted)
2. Read the HU display and check that the rear view camera image is displayed in Automatic Display Mode
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts = 1 (Inserted) is sent
2. The rear view camera image stays displayed and the mode changes to Automatic Display Mode
tcs.test_item:
· When STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = [RUN], RVC image active, Shift Lever chagne to Reverse Gear_Stat.info = [REVERSE] > Reverse_Deb, the Head Unit shall continue to display RVC image and switch to the Automatic Display mode.

(Atl-Mi, read the HU display and check that the rear view camera image is displayed in Automatic Display Mode)

reasoning: 驗證目標同 NR1L-RVC-011，惟為 Atl-Mi 半邊；verbatim 取 SYS-RA-VF551_V3-266（V3 §1.10.2.3），與 V2-488 為對應之雙生條文（兩者之 VF anchor 序號皆為 484）。來源之 Gear_Stat.info 為內部訊號，依 §8.7.5(f) 轉為 STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts（P363 與 637MCA 兩本 DBC BO_ 996，VAL_ 1 "Inserted"）。VF551_V42（637）以 TRANSM2.ShiftLeverPosition 書寫同一觸發，該 message 不在四本 DBC（A-CA23／DR-CAM-f），補件後須複核本列對 637 是否成立。
